== Biography ==
Matthew was born in 1715. He is the son of [[Glasgow-2463|John Glasgow]] and [[Wyllie-1044|Jean Wyllie]].
== Research Notes ==
=== Individual father review, 22 October 2026 ===

This dated review supersedes any earlier grade of this pair within the stated record scope. The existing father [[Glasgow-1065]] is assessed at 89% (probable). Matthew’s 1715 entry gives John Glasgow and Jean Wyllie at Laigh Fergushill, matching Margaret 1712. This identifies one adult family more securely than it identifies the father with the 1683 child.

Record names the adult father; the complete inherited edge includes unproved 1683-to-adult continuity.

Next useful test: Inspect p111 against p87 and seek John/Jean marriage; reconcile 29 October birth,5 November baptism and 2 November field.
